description: Industry-wide loan balances and net charge-offs by loan category for FDIC-insured banks, summed from every institution's call report: construction and land development, multifamily, nonfarm nonresidential (commercial real estate), commercial and industrial, consumer and farm. Returns balances and year-to-date net charge-offs in thousands of dollars, each category's share of total loans, and net charge-off rates (year-to-date and annualized, on period-end balances). Use for commercial real estate concentration or charge-off rates by property type. Defaults to the latest quarter reported; pass `date` (YYYYMMDD quarter end, e.g. "20251231") or `state` (two-letter postal code) to narrow.

date.description: Quarter-end report date as YYYYMMDD ("20251231"). Omit for the latest quarter published.

state.description: Optional two-letter state postal code of the bank's headquarters ("CA"). Omit for all US banks.
